memories:
- User is working on Project Wren, a batch job that renders thumbnails for uploaded photos, which needs its first AWS environment set up during the week of October 24, 2026.
- User requires every Terraform resource they write to be tagged with Owner = "data-team"
- User defaults to the eu-central-1 region for AWS deployments
- Project Wren reads photo uploads from an existing S3 bucket owned by the mobile team; it does not manage the upload storage itself.
- User's AWS Lambda free tier includes one million requests and 400,000 GB-seconds of compute per month.
- The Project Wren thumbnail job currently takes about 4 seconds per photo to process.
- User specified deploying Project Wren to us-west-2 because most mobile users are located in California, overriding their default eu-central-1 preference for this project.
- Most photos processed by Project Wren are 12 megapixel originals, with some being larger.
- User was advised to downscale images during decode rather than resizing after a full decode to improve performance for large 12-megapixel photos in Project Wren.
